items.quote: Den ausstehenden Betrag erbitten wir bis spätestens Freitag, den 27. Februar 2026 auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: Friday, 27 February 2026. This is a private payment reminder (Hausverwaltung acting as landlord's agent), not a statutory period to be counted; the date is used exactly as written. 27 February 2026 falls on a Friday, a normal working day (not a weekend or public holiday in NW), so no adjustment under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 2026-02-27.

warnings: This is a private payment reminder from a property management company for a 2024 utility-cost settlement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) referenced but not attached; verify the underlying settlement (dated 15.12.2025) actually shows this balance before paying, and confirm you have not already paid it as the letter itself suggests checking.

The letter provides a specific IBAN/BIC for payment; as a general precaution when paying any invoice, verify these bank details independently (e.g. against a prior statement or by calling the management company) before transferring money.
